content:
**Ripper Alley** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

A former Raider camp on State Route 107, Ripper Alley guarded the approach to the West Tek Research Center. At some point before 2102, the Raiders either fled, were killed, or infected, leaving the camp to the Scorched. The area has been occupied by Blood Eagles since 2103.

Ripper Alley is located next to a winding mountain road just west of the research center. It contains a Cooking Station at the end of the alley, next to a locked Suitcase and an Explosives Crate. The Van built into the junk wall is explodable.

Ripper Alley appears in *Fallout 76*.
